name: memory_recall
description: Search persistent memory. Call BEFORE starting a task that resembles past work. Returns the top word matches, never fewer than the store default of 3 when that many match; a query that is exactly a fact's name returns that fact alone.

query.description: Words a past-you would have used to describe the fact

k.description: Facts wanted. Raised to the store default of 3 when smaller; never lowered below it.
